policy: Same fixed handoff cue on 18 Piper and 12 Kokoro direct mic recordings and 16 two-room inputs. No holdout or human speech. Zero playback reference. Check both P4 FIFO hashes against raw mic and its delayed copy. For diagnosis crop the same labelled source interval before and after Opus using measured lane correlation delay. The deployable OPEN-minus-100-ms window uses only the recorded trigger. Full history and that window use the entire decoded tail. Same unprompted English beam-3 FP16 GPU decoding, word timestamps, temperature zero, no VAD. Words scored after the fixed normalization. Original utterance includes its original spoken address for the direct sources.
